text: Carousel: a single slide renders as that slide, with no controls and no carousel semantics; past six slides, a hairline under the "3 / 9" counter is the rotation timer, since there is no dot to fill. New story OverlayLongSet. Figma: the carousel is rebuilt as parts (Arrow, Rotation, Dot, Counter, Slide), controls and a full Carousel for desktop, tablet and phone, prototype-ready.
